sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi iisang tao lang ang nagpapasya sa akreditasyon — may sistema ito, may itinalagang responsibilidad, at may talaang pinapanatili.
sections.takeaway_en: Accreditation isn't decided by one person alone — it runs through a system, with assigned responsibility and a registry that's kept up to date.
